title: gatewatch: merged constitution change without explicit human sign-off
description: Evidence: commit b5c7748fde27bfed419b3d4d9e1ea7d3621655fc, docs/CONSTITUTION.md lines 1-142 (new file). Article IX requires changes to the constitution to receive explicit human review and not ride an auto-merged PR. The merged history shows this mandate file was introduced by an ordinary merged commit; no explicit human sign-off is recorded in the commit subject/body or diff. Article VIII requires SHA and paths; both are provided.

title: gatewatch: merged audit trigger change without explicit human sign-off
description: Evidence: commit b9e47516e54b0612491b373bbcf9e055f91b39e9, .warren/triggers.yaml lines 1-47 (new file, including gatewatch-patrol, ratchetwatch-patrol, and tastewatch-sample audit entries). Article IX requires changes to .warren/triggers.yaml audit entries to receive explicit human review and not ride an auto-merged PR. The merged history shows the protected audit-trigger file was introduced by an ordinary merged commit; no explicit human sign-off is recorded in the commit subject/body or diff. Article VIII evidence: SHA and path/lines included.

title: gatewatch: title claims automated workflow standardization but diff only adds constitution
description: Evidence: commit b5c7748fde27bfed419b3d4d9e1ea7d3621655fc, subject 'chore(governance): standardize CONSTITUTION.md and automated workflows'; git show --stat reports only docs/CONSTITUTION.md (142 lines added), with no workflow file changed. Article I requires commit titles/descriptions to truthfully describe their diff; the subject claims automated workflow standardization not present in the diff. Article VIII evidence: SHA and path included.
